name: Risen Undercity
description: The sections of the Undercity raised to the surface and exposed to sunlight.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, sections of the Undercity are torn open and thrust skyward by the Invasion Tree's branches, exposing buried terrain to sunlight.
timeline.quote: massive sections of its hidden tunnels and ruins were torn open and thrust skyward by the spreading branches of the Invasion Tree

timeline.summary: Exposure to sunlight gives rise to new species and plant mutations in the Risen Undercity, studied by botanists and Simic researchers.
timeline.quote: This so-called Risen Undercity gave rise to new species and unusual plant mutations
